limitations: Automated economy evidence, not a human gameplay session.
Threats and combat remain absent; route escort readiness is not combat.
Simulated elapsed time includes waiting for labor, arrivals, research and production.
Automated stock-target staffing is more frequent and precise than ordinary player control.
